stories.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
stories.body: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

stories.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
stories.body: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

stories.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
stories.body: Another 21 are injured after the tanker reportedly overturns on a busy ring road in the Egyptian capital.

stories.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
stories.body: The Israeli PM says his trial should end after judges said there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases.

stories.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
stories.body: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

stories.title: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
stories.body: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.

stories.title: California warns of flooding as king tides peak over Thanksgiving
stories.body: Parts of the Canadian province of British Columbia may also be affected by the storms, which come as millions of people travel for the holiday.

stories.title: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show
stories.body: A review of the US president's financial disclosures shows Donald Trump's investment portfolios have regularly traded shares in the tech giant.

stories.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade due to weather
stories.body: The was the first time ever that the iconic celebration - known for its massive balloons floating past the city's skyscrapers - was delayed because of storms.

stories.title: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt settle legal battle over French winery
stories.body: The Hollywood A-listers' legal battle focused on the vineyard they bought in 2008 and where they wed six years later.

stories.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
stories.body: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.

stories.title: My family were killed in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
stories.body: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.

stories.title: Russia's own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in Ukraine war
stories.body: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia.

stories.title: Israeli strike kills senior Hamas security official and family in Gaza City
stories.body: Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, head of Hamas's internal security service in northern Gaza, was killed with his wife and two teenage daughters, doctors say.

stories.title: Five Russian military jets hit in airfield strike, says Ukraine
stories.body: The Savasleyka airfield hosts aircraft used by Russia to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs at Ukraine.

stories.title: Protesters call on Israel to free Palestinian student held without charge
stories.body: Mahdi Tunsi, 26, was taken from his university dormitory earlier this month and has since been held without charge.

stories.title: Colombian police storm supermarket to free 76 held hostage for 17 hours
stories.body: One gunman was killed after what the country's president described as a robbery of a cash-laden armoured car gone wrong.

stories.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing US trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
stories.body: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.

stories.title: Canadian astronaut welcomes baby girl from space station
stories.body: Joshua Kutryk, currently on his first space mission, is just the fourth astronaut in history to miss the birth of a child while aboard the International Space Station.

stories.title: What we know about Trump's Thanksgiving tariffs
stories.body: Donald Trump is targeting China, the European Union and 12 other jurisdictions in a new round of tariffs.
